name: St. Peter's Cream Stout Gluten Free
food_pairings: Kettle Matured Cheddar Cheese & Red Onions
Kettle Intense Truffle and Sea Salt
notes: Deep brown almost black gluten-free stout. Smooth roasted malt and coffee aroma with subtle chocolate sweetness and mild bitterness. Medium bodied, velvety slightly creamy finish.
notes_de: Tiefbraunes, fast schwarzes, glutenfreies Stout. Sanftes Röstmalz- und Kaffee-Aroma mit dezenter Schokoladensüße und milder Bitterkeit. Mittlerer Körper mit samtigem, leicht cremigem Abgang.
